packs: math

=== sqrt
needs host-math
(sqrt 16)
--- want
4

=== sqrt negative
needs host-math
(sqrt -1)
--- error

=== abs negative
(abs -5)
--- want
5

=== abs positive
(abs 5)
--- want
5

=== floor
(floor 2.7)
--- want
2

=== floor negative
(floor -2.7)
--- want
-3

=== ceil
(ceil 2.1)
--- want
3

=== round half up
(round 2.5)
--- want
3

=== round half away from zero
(round -2.5)
--- want
-3

=== to-int truncates
(to-int 2.7)
--- want
2

=== to-int truncates toward zero
(to-int -2.7)
--- want
-2

=== math-min
(math-min 3 1 2)
--- want
1

=== math-max
(math-max 3 1 2)
--- want
3

=== math-min needs an argument
(math-min)
--- error

=== pi
(> (pi) 3.14159)
--- want
#t

=== e
(> (e) 2.718)
--- want
#t

=== exp and log round-trip
needs host-math
(round (log (exp 3)))
--- want
3

=== log10
needs host-math
(log10 1000)
--- want
3

=== sin zero
needs host-math
(sin 0)
--- want
0

=== cos zero
needs host-math
(cos 0)
--- want
1

=== tan zero
needs host-math
(tan 0)
--- want
0
